reuse.why: Writes a new inline worst-case ternary in toExternal instead of extracting the furthest-from-zero logic already inlined in computeSchedulePreviewTransactions into a shared #shared/schedules function (or extending getScheduledAmount).

duplication.why: The number/range/furthest-from-zero dispatch now exists in both the preview and the API model, with a different tie-break (> vs >=) and a different missing-amount check.

placement.why: Computing the field in scheduleModel.toExternal is the right layer, but the amount rule itself is domain logic that belongs in #shared/schedules, not the API mapping.

scope.why: Focused on the API model, its types and a test; the Omit on schedule-create is a reasonable consequence of adding the field to the shared API type.

maintainability.why: A third, slightly different copy of the expected-amount rule means the API can disagree with what the app previews and posts as soon as either copy changes.

bypasses_abstraction.where: server/api-models.ts scheduleModel.toExternal computes expectedAmount itself rather than going through #shared/schedules (getScheduledAmount / the preview's worst-case rule).

disguised_duplication.where: server/api-models.ts toExternal: the preview's furthest-from-zero ternary from shared/schedules.ts computeSchedulePreviewTransactions reshaped with an undefined-endpoint check and a strict > comparison.
